title: RALLY
notes: Played through the Desert course in Arcade Mode.
issues: Tried both the Software Rendering version and the Direct3D patch. Both versions display the game on the bottom right corner of the screen. The Direct3D version runs extremely slow, one frame per sometimes. The software version has a white flashing line above the gameplay, but lowering the game resolution to 320x240 eliminates this. On the MacBook Neo’s screen this causes the actual size of the gameplay window to be about that of a saltine cracker.  Game sounds played perfectly however there was no music due to the nature of the game using Redbook Audio. This could possibly be fixed using _inmm in the game’s installation directory. The actual performance of the software version is very good, running at full speed without any of the frame-pacing issues that plauge the game when running on modern Windows. I know this is a super ancient game and it is much easier to run this game on Mac using 86box, but I thought it would be a cool experiment to see how well Highball would work with legacy software.
